**Map the saved Sonnet 4.5 preference to Sonnet 4.6 when restoring it.** Returning users with a saved `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` preference no longer match any option. `getStoredModelPreference` returns `null`, so `getDefaultModelOption` selects `MODEL_OPTIONS[0]`, the OpenAI `gpt-6.1-sol` option. The page then sends OpenAI as the provider. Map the legacy model ID to `claude-sonnet-4-6` before the lookup.
Suggested fix

```diff +const LEGACY_MODEL_IDS: Record = { + 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929': 'claude-sonnet-4-6', +} + export function getStoredModelPreference(): ModelOption | null { if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null try { const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) if (!stored) return null const parsed = JSON.parse(stored) as { provider: Provider; model: string } + const model = LEGACY_MODEL_IDS[parsed.model] ?? parsed.model const option = MODEL_OPTIONS.find( - (opt) => opt.provider === parsed.provider && opt.model === parsed.model, + (opt) => opt.provider === parsed.provider && opt.model === model, ) return option || null } catch { return null } } ```

**Migrate saved Sonnet 4.5 preferences when they are restored.** A returning user with a saved `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` preference matches no `MODEL_OPTIONS` entry. `getStoredModelPreference` returns `null`, and `getDefaultModelOption` returns `MODEL_OPTIONS[0]`, the OpenAI entry. Requests then use the `openai` provider. The saved Anthropic choice is ignored on every load until the user selects a model again. When `OPENAI_API_KEY` is unset, `openaiText` throws. A user who has only an Anthropic key gets that error on each chat request in this state. Map the retired ID when the stored preference is read, so the saved provider is kept:
Suggested fix

```diff const parsed = JSON.parse(stored) as { provider: Provider; model: string } + const model = + parsed.provider === 'anthropic' && + parsed.model === 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929' + ? 'claude-sonnet-4-6' + : parsed.model const option = MODEL_OPTIONS.find( - (opt) => opt.provider === parsed.provider && opt.model === parsed.model, + (opt) => opt.provider === parsed.provider && opt.model === model, ) ```
